title: Add suppliers to the product catalog
goal: Extend the existing stock-enabled products-app prototype with a second resource for suppliers and connect products to suppliers through product create/edit and list filtering.
acceptance_criteria: Existing product create, edit, list, search, category filter, stock quantity, availability filter, Adjust Stock action, and availability label behavior remains working.
User can create a supplier with name and contact email in the existing product catalog prototype context.
User can select a supplier when creating a product.
User can change a product supplier when editing a product.
Product list displays the supplier name for products that have a supplier.
User can filter products by supplier and see only products assigned to the selected supplier.
The incremental run extends the existing product catalog implementation rather than creating a separate unrelated application.
constraints: Use the previous adjusted-stock products-app run as the baseline via --from-run, for example runs/run-007-products-adjust-stock.
Preserve the existing /api/products resource and existing ProductCatalogScreen root screen.
Add suppliers as a second lightweight resource in the same prototype: supplier model, supplier service, supplier API, and supplier mock JSON are allowed.
Prefer extending the existing ProductCatalogScreen and ProductSearchFilter rather than replacing them.
Product supplier selection may be implemented with supplier_id stored on Product and supplier name resolved in UI, service, or API response, as long as the demo behavior is visible and consistent.
Do not add product delete behavior.
Do not add purchase orders, supplier scoring, contracts, procurement workflow, authentication, external integrations, or database migrations.
Continue using local JSON mock storage.
non_goals: Changing existing stock and availability filter semantics.
